messages:
elliot: starting a config-only push for batch/window and route floors in tonight's 21:30-22:15 PT window. canary 1% to non-critical tenants.
deploy-bot: queued deploy_id=deploy-3099991234, mode=config-only, target=prod, canary=1%
mei: ack. i'll watch traces and per-tenant tails. subscribing to alerts.
rick: drop the diff pls. want to check per-request bypass rule.
elliot: config snippet:
```json
{
  "routing": {"min_weight_pct": 4, "balance": "latency"},
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 3072, "max_batch_size": 40, "window_ms": 10},
  "timeouts": {"head_ms": 950, "stream_idle_ms": 30000}
}
```
mei: launching canary -> 1% to tweak variant
deploy-bot: canary live: tweak variant receiving 1% traffic
obs-bot: canary stats (5m): p50=38ms, p95=150ms, p99=295ms, error_rate=0.00%
...6m later...
mei: seeing a few large single-request traces queuing ~120ms waiting for batch fill; affected tenant: partner-beta. p99 for partner-beta ~480ms.
rick: that's likely due to max_batch_size=40 + window_ms=10. propose hotpatch to add per_request_bypass_size=16 and set window_ms->6 for tweak only.
elliot: good call. pausing ramp. will hotpatch tweak variant. include explicit rollback in notes.
deploy-bot: hotpatch command: `/deploy config-only --patch '{"batching":{"per_request_bypass_size":16,"window_ms":6}}' --to prod --variant=tweak --canary 1%`
deploy-bot: hotpatch started: patch_id=patch-3099992001 status=canarying
obs-bot: hotpatch canary (3m): p50=36ms, p95=140ms, p99(partner-beta)=210ms, error_rate=0.00%
mei: tail improved. recommend ramp to 20% over 10m. documenting rollback: `/deploy rollback deploy-3099991234` or reapply previous config hash cfg-9c3a.
elliot: ramping patch-3099992001 -> 20%
obs-bot: stable at 20% after 12m. p95 down, no errors.
rick: pinning cfg-9c3a to variant v16 for 24h as a safety net. rollout owner=elliot, rollback-owner=mei. rollback triggers: any tenant 5xx > 0.35% OR sustained p99 delta +200ms for 5m.
mei: adding short playbook in the ticket with quick rollback steps and the deploy commands.
elliot: release note draft: "Config-only: routing.min_weight_pct 0->4, batching.max_batch_size 64->40, batching.window_ms 12->10 then hotpatched to 6 for per-request latency; added batching.per_request_bypass_size=16 to avoid stalling large single requests. Pinned cfg-9c3a to v16 for 24h. Change window closed 21:52 PT."
mei: thanks, closing thread unless alerts trigger. :white_check_mark:
